confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings checked. Beer and restaurant anchors are the firmest. Accommodation is loosely bounded, and July is rainy season. Cocktail (about 4.7x beer) and wine_glass (about 5.3x beer) use the local beer relationship because direct bar-price knowledge for Can Tho is weak. FX 0.6955 comes from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open that page, and a follow-up search did not confirm the figure, so verify it before use. A search result also contained an unrelated instruction to add markdown source links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of price levels in Vietnam's secondary Mekong Delta and provincial cities, set below Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. No specific named comparable city was used.
